petName.title: Pet name
petName.description: Name used in the status line and speech (e.g. "ECHO正在幸福地听 …").

enableSteamStatus.title: Steam Rich Presence augmentation
enableSteamStatus.description: Augment ECHO's native Steam Rich Presence with the pet status line (listening / working / idle), keeping ECHO's own steam_display tokens. Event-driven — no polling. When off (or when ECHO is not running as its Steam build), the native presence is never touched.

steamStatusMode.title: Steam status mode
steamStatusMode.description: What the Steam Rich Presence line contains while the bridge is enabled. "native-augment": the full pet line fused with ECHO's now-playing info ("ECHO正在幸福地听 …", current behavior). "pet-only": only the pet's own doings (打工 / 睡大觉 / 发呆), never the track, leaving music status to ECHO itself. "off": push nothing (same effect as disabling the bridge).

steamCustomTemplate.title: Custom Steam status template
steamCustomTemplate.description: Optional template that overrides the composed status line for Steam only (the on-pet status chip keeps the composed line). Placeholders: {petName}, {mode} (happy/nomal/poorcondition/ill), {state} (nomal/work/sleep), {track} and {artist} (empty when no music), {petLine} (the composed pet line). Example: "{petName} ♪ {track} — {artist}". Leave empty to use the composed line.

steamShowTrackInPetLine.title: Show track in Steam pet line
steamShowTrackInPetLine.description: Include the current track ("正在听 {title} · {artist}") in the pet line pushed to Steam (native-augment mode and the {petLine} template placeholder). When off, Steam gets the plain pet line (发呆 / 打工 / 睡大觉) even while music plays; the on-pet status chip is unaffected.

autoBuy.title: Auto-buy food & drink
autoBuy.description: When hunger or thirst falls below 25%, automatically buy the cheapest suitable meal/drink if the pet can afford it (pays a 20% convenience fee, like VPet).

enableRoaming.title: Pet roaming
enableRoaming.description: When idle, the pet occasionally strolls left/right along its screen edge (VPet-style walk), staying inside the display work area. Pauses automatically while dragging, sleeping, working, or when panels/menus are open.

showActivationToast.title: Show activation toast
showActivationToast.description: Show a toast in the main window when the classic pet takes over.

persistentDock.title: Always-visible action dock
persistentDock.description: Keep the action dock (shop / schedule / stats / sleep / dance) always visible instead of only showing it while hovering the pet.

interactDurationMs.title: Interact animation duration (ms)
interactDurationMs.description: How long the interact animation plays after clicking the pet (500–20000 ms).

showActionDock.title: Show action dock
showActionDock.description: Show the hover action dock (商店 / 日程 / 状态 / 睡觉 / 跳舞) on the pet. When hidden, the same actions stay available from the right-click menu.

showTransportControls.title: Show transport controls
showTransportControls.description: Show the hover playback pill (上一首 / 播放暂停 / 下一首) at the bottom of the pet.

showWindowControls.title: Show window controls
showWindowControls.description: Show the hover reset-position / hide buttons in the pet's top-right corner. When hidden, 重置位置 / 隐藏桌宠 stay available from the right-click menu and the sidebar page.

showStatusBar.title: Show status chip
showStatusBar.description: Show the VPet-style status line chip ("ECHO正在幸福地听 …") at the bottom of the pet. Steam Rich Presence keeps working while it is hidden.

showSpeechBubble.title: Show speech bubble
showSpeechBubble.description: Show the pet speech bubble (eating / work / level-up / begging / chatter lines). Gameplay effects still apply while it is hidden.

showWorkTimer.title: Show work timer card
showWorkTimer.description: Show the running work/study/play timer card pinned above the pet. Jobs still run and finish normally while it is hidden (stop them from the 日程 panel).

showContextMenu.title: Enable right-click menu
showContextMenu.description: Enable the VPet-style right-click menu on the pet. The action dock and panel windows keep working when disabled.
